item.title: Rajasthan Approves Hybrid Inverters for Rooftop Solar Amid Growing BESS Focus
item.description: Jaipur Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited (JVVNL) has now allowed the use of hybrid inverters for Rooftop Solar (RTS) systems in Rajasthan. JVVNL brought the latest notice in view of the increasing Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) use, which has assumed importance in the power distribution network. The state's need for the BESS project is being driven by increasing renewable energy sources integration and the growing need to manage grid stability, peak load management, and improve power quality. item.title: Mahavitaran Slashes Rooftop Solar Cost to ₹45,450 per kW, Saving Consumers ₹15,000
item.description: Maharashtra has taken a step to make residential solar more affordable, with Mahavitaran (MSEDCL) finalising a new benchmark rate of ₹45,450 per kW for rooftop solar installations under the Swayampurna Maharashtra Residential Rooftop Solar (SMART) scheme. The revised pricing, approved through a competitive tender process, is nearly ₹15,000 lower than the prevailing market rate of ₹60,000 per kW and ₹4,550 below the state’s earlier estimated project cost of ₹50,000 per kW. item.title: Maharashtra Renewable Energy and Storage Policy 2025–2035 Targets 65% Green Power
item.description: The Maharashtra government has approved a comprehensive policy aimed at strengthening renewable energy deployment while addressing the challenge of power storage. The Maharashtra Renewable Energy and Energy Storage Policy 2025-2035, cleared by the state cabinet, lays out a long-term roadmap to store clean energy and ensure its availability during peak demand hours. item.title: Adani Green Operationalises 185 MW Wind Plant in Gujarat’s Khavda
item.description: Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL) has operationalised a 185 MW wind power project at Khavda in Gujarat. The project has been commissioned through Adani Green Energy Limited’s wholly-owned stepdown subsidiary, Adani Green Energy Twenty Five C Limited. The company confirmed that the project achieved operational status on February 28, 2026. Power generation from the facility is scheduled to begin from March 01, 2026, subject to requisite clearances. item.title: Group Surya Commissions 500 MW G12R Solar Module Manufacturing Line in Odisha
item.description: Group Surya, the parent company of Surya International Enterprise Limited, has commissioned a new G12R solar module production line at its facility in Bhubaneswar, marking what the company says is the first manufacturing line in the state capable of producing G12R modules. The fully automated production line has an annual manufacturing capacity of 500 MW and operates with a cycle time of about 20–25 seconds per module. item.title: GAIL Expands Renewable Portfolio with 178.2 MW Maharashtra Wind Project
item.description: State-owned gas major GAIL (India) Ltd has approved an investment of ₹1,736.25 crore to develop a 178.2 MW wind power project in Maharashtra, marking a significant expansion of its renewable energy portfolio as the company advances towards its net zero targets. The decision was cleared by the company’s board during a meeting held on Friday, according to a regulatory filing. item.title: RenewSys Signs Deal to Supply 125 MWp of TOPCon Solar Modules to ENGIE
item.description: Indian solar module manufacturer RenewSys India Pvt. Ltd. has signed a supply agreement with ENGIE to provide 125 MWp of TOPCon solar PV modules for a solar project in Bikaner, Rajasthan. Deliveries are scheduled between February and April 2026, the company said. The modules will be deployed at ENGIE’s upcoming solar installation, supporting the company’s growing renewable energy portfolio in India.
